This article compares the exclusion reasons for indicator 6 at the regional level, detailing why patients are removed from the clinical quality assessment across [[danmark|Danmark]] and its five administrative regions: [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]], [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]], [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]], [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]], and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] [^src1]. Understanding these exclusions is critical for evaluating the true denominator of the quality indicator and identifying whether patients are being filtered out for clinical, demographic, or administrative reasons.

The data reveals a massive outlier in the exclusion criteria: the vast majority of patients are excluded simply because they were not operated on ("Patienten er ikke opereret") [^src1]. Nationally, this single criterion accounts for 6,646 exclusions, dwarfing all other categories combined [^src1]. When breaking down this dominant exclusion reason by region, [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] is the leader with 1,609 excluded patients, while [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] is the trailer with 992 [^src1]. 

The second most common reason for exclusion nationally is that the recorded surgery was not the first operation during the patient's hospital stay, accounting for 544 cases [^src1]. Once again, [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] records the highest volume of these exclusions (188), and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] records the lowest (29) [^src1]. Demographic and administrative exclusions make up the smallest fractions of the data. Exclusions due to the patient being under 18 years old total 177 nationally, led by [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] (67) and trailed by [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] (9) [^src1]. Finally, invalid CPR numbers result in only 79 national exclusions, ranging from 31 in [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] down to just 8 in [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] [^src1].

Because this comparison is built from a single dated section in the 2025 report, it is not possible to establish longitudinal trends, improvements, or declines over time [^src1]. However, the static snapshot clearly demonstrates that clinical pathways (whether a patient ultimately receives surgery) drive the overwhelming majority of exclusions for indicator 6, rather than data entry errors or age restrictions.

Further details on other clinical indicators, regional performance metrics, and historical data are documented across the broader AKDB annual reports and supplementary sections [^src2][^src3][^src4][^src5][^src6][^src7][^src8][^src9][^src10][^src11][^src12][^src13][^src14][^src15][^src16][^src17][^src18][^src19][^src20][^src21][^src22][^src23][^src24][^src25].

## Table: AKDB_2025.pdf, p. 38

Rows compare: exclusion reasons · Columns show: number of patients per region

| Årsag | Danmark | Hovedstaden | Sjælland | Syddanmark | Midtjylland | Nordjylland |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ugyldigt CPRnummer. | 79 | 31 | 10 | 19 | 11 | 8 |
| Patienten er under 18 år. | 177 | 67 | 9 | 53 | 36 | 12 |
| Patienten er ikke opereret. | 6.646 | 1.609 | 1.024 | 1.442 | 1.579 | 992 |
| Operationen er ikke den første operation i hospitalsopholdet. | 544 | 188 | 77 | 143 | 107 | 29 |

Entities: danmark, region-hovedstaden, region-sjaelland, region-syddanmark, region-midtjylland, region-nordjylland

Summary: Tabellen viser antallet af patienter ekskluderet fra indikator 6 på grund af ugyldigt CPR-nummer, alderskrav, manglende operation eller sekundær operation, og fremhæver 'Patienten er ikke opereret' som den dominerende eksklusionsgrund på tværs af regionerne.
